label: ABC2_oP8_59_a_b_e-001
title: $\theta$-Zr$_{2}$CuAu Structure
comments:
At low temperatures, the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C_cF16_225_a_c_b-001}{heusler structure $\beta$-Zr$_{2}$CuAu} has a martensitic transformation to this phase.  The data was taken at 78K. 
 (Duggin, 1966) places this in the $P2mm$ setting of polar space group \#25 (standard setting $Pmm2$), but the numerical values of the Wyckoff positions place it in the centrosymmetric space group $Pmmn$. We used AFLOW to determine the transformation.
